doc: CI's lanes (D-248, D-254): what a run can test, each lane a row of the matrix, a job of ci.yml or a workflow of its own, with what it checks and about how many runner minutes it takes (the last runs': 2026-11-18). A run tests the lanes its event selects: a pull request's push the lint alone, unless the head commit's last paragraph says which (a trailer `CI: macos windows`, `CI: all -android`, `CI: pages`), which are then requested as a run of their own; a run by hand the lanes it is given (gh workflow run CI -f lanes=…, or omui-devtools ci request …); main and the nightly schedule their defaults below. A selection is names separated by spaces or commas, read left to right: a lane or a group adds, `-name` takes away, `none` empties. omui-devtools ci plan says what a commit would run, and its minutes, before it is pushed.

lanes.name: linux
lanes.what: Linux x64: every member built and tested, the incremental build, the agent, sweep, screen reader, distribution, size and template checks
